key_insight: Jianmu-Q uses specialized AI agents to translate natural-language descriptions of quantum field theories into validation-guided quantum simulation workflows.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects theoretical formulation to quantum-circuit design and hardware execution, addressing a key integration challenge in field-theory simulation.
method: Coordinate agents for theoretical formulation, lattice discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit design.
Validate intermediate results with physical consistency checks and independent numerical calculations.
Benchmark noiseless circuits and execute selected circuits on IBM quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: Across the (1+1)D Nambu–Jona-Lasinio and Schwinger models and a (2+1)D Z₂ gauge theory, noiseless circuit simulations converge toward independent exact-diagonalization and tensor-network results.
watch_item: Selected hardware executions demonstrate feasibility, but the abstract does not establish noise robustness, scalability, or quantum advantage.
paper_title: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
